description: Versioned Markdown prompt suite for frontend UX tasks (diagnose, design, refine, verify, review). Consumed via src/prompts/frontend-ux.js and registered in prompts/index.json; it is not a competing catalog.

schema.id: stable dot-free identifier shared by the prompt frontmatter and index.json
schema.file: prompt file path relative to prompts/frontend-ux/
schema.activation: condition gating the prompt to frontend UX tasks

prompts.requiredInput: DOM snapshot, user logs, task context
prompts.expectedOutput: { findings: [{ type: "observed" | "hypothesis", location, severity, evidence }], notes }
prompts.constraints: Do not invent usability findings, satisfaction scores, or quantitative improvements without evidence.
prompts.evidenceRequirements: Each observed finding cites location and what was observed; hypotheses are marked unverified.
prompts.fallback: Return empty findings with an explanatory note when the context is missing.

prompts.requiredInput: diagnosis findings, product constraints, task context
prompts.expectedOutput: { changes: [{ target, intent, findingRef, type }], openQuestions }
prompts.constraints: Do not invent usability findings or claim quantitative improvements without evidence.
prompts.evidenceRequirements: Every proposed change cites a finding reference labeled observed or hypothesis.
prompts.fallback: Return an empty change list and list what context is required when findings are absent.

prompts.requiredInput: design proposal, current markup/styles, task context
prompts.expectedOutput: { edits: [{ location, change, findingRef, type }], risks }
prompts.constraints: Prefer the smallest change that addresses the finding; do not invent findings or metrics.
prompts.evidenceRequirements: Each edit cites the finding it addresses and labels it observed or hypothesis.
prompts.fallback: Return an empty edit list with a note when the design proposal is missing.

prompts.requiredInput: applied refinements, observed behavior, task context
prompts.expectedOutput: { checks: [{ claim, evidence, result, type }], unverified }
prompts.constraints: Do not mark a claim verified without observed evidence; no quantitative claims without evidence.
prompts.evidenceRequirements: Every verified claim cites observed evidence; unsupported claims land in unverified.
prompts.fallback: Return all claims under unverified with a note when no evidence is available.

prompts.requiredInput: change diff, verification result, task context
prompts.expectedOutput: { verdict, findings: [{ type: "observed" | "hypothesis", location, severity }], followUps }
prompts.constraints: Do not invent usability findings or quantitative improvements without evidence.
prompts.evidenceRequirements: Findings cite location and evidence; hypotheses are marked unverified.
prompts.fallback: Return verdict "insufficient-context" with the missing inputs when the diff or evidence is absent.
